questions.question_english: Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB) is a budgeting method in which:
options_english: Every proposed expenditure must be justified from a zero base for each new period
The annual institutional budget is prepared assuming zero total anticipated expenditure across all administrative heads
Only capital infrastructure expenditures require justification, while routine revenue expenditures are automatically renewed each year
Any remaining unspent cash balance at the end of the financial year is automatically reduced to zero by the banking authorities
questions.explanation_english: Every proposed expenditure must be justified from a zero base for each new period. Zero-Based Budgeting is a rigorous financial methodology requiring every proposed expenditure to be thoroughly evaluated and justified from a zero base for each new budget cycle. Rather than relying on historical spending levels as an automatic baseline, administrators must demonstrate the necessity, cost-effectiveness, and priority of every activity before funds are allocated
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। ZBB में हर नए बजट चक्र में प्रत्येक प्रस्तावित खर्च को शुरू से उचित ठहराना पड़ता है; पुराने आवंटन अपने-आप जारी नहीं रहते।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

questions.question_english: Review the following steps of Performance Budgeting: I. Establishment of performance targets and indicators. II. Formulation of broad educational objectives. III. Evaluation of actual performance against established targets. IV. Allocation of resources to specific programs and activities. Which of these represents the correct logical sequence of these steps?
options_english: II, IV, I, III
II, I, IV, III
I, II, IV, III
IV, II, I, III
questions.explanation_english: II, IV, I, III. The logical sequence of Performance Budgeting begins with formulating broad educational objectives. Next, financial resources are allocated to specific programs and operational activities. Following resource distribution, precise performance targets and measurable indicators are established. Finally, actual physical performance and program outcomes are evaluated against these predetermined targets, completing the structured cycle of performance- based financial administration
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। पहले व्यापक उद्देश्य तय होते हैं, फिर लक्ष्य और संकेतक बनाए जाते हैं, उनके अनुरूप संसाधन आवंटित होते हैं और अंत में वास्तविक निष्पादन का मूल्यांकन होता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

questions.question_english: Consider the two statements below: Assertion (A) and Reason (R): Assertion (A): All anticipated savings should be surrendered to the Government immediately when they are foreseen, without waiting till the end of the year. Reason (R): Prompt surrender of savings allows the Finance Department to re-appropriate those funds to other departments or schemes that are facing a deficit.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A. Financial rules require that anticipated savings be surrendered immediately when foreseen, without waiting for the end of the year. Prompt surrender allows the Finance Department to reallocate unutilized funds to meet deficits in other essential public schemes. This administrative utility directly explains why early surrender of savings is mandatory under financial rules
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। बचत का समय रहते समर्पण वित्त विभाग को घाटे वाले अन्य विभागों या योजनाओं में धन पुनः आवंटित करने का अवसर देता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (A)

options_hindi: सभी जारी खर्च तत्काल रोक देना और नए बजट चक्र की प्रतीक्षा करना

questions.question_english: A newly appointed Principal discovers that the school has historically spent funds on activities without prior financial planning or alignment with the School Development Plan (SDP). Which is the most suitable first step the Principal should take to rectify this situation for the upcoming financial year?
options_english: Immediately suspend all ongoing expenditures and wait for the new budget cycle
Initiate a structured budget preparation process integrating the SDP priorities with estimated costs
Delegate all financial decision-making to the School Management Committee (SMC)
Request an emergency supplementary budget from the Directorate of Education to cover unplanned expenses
questions.explanation_english: Initiate a structured budget preparation process integrating the SDP priorities with estimated costs. Effective school administration requires systematic financial planning aligned with institutional objectives. Initiating a structured budget preparation process integrates the priorities of the School Development Plan with realistic cost estimations. This proactive approach eliminates ad-hoc spending, establishes strong financial discipline, ensures equitable distribution of resources across departments, and aligns upcoming financial expenditures directly with long-term educational growth targets
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। पहला कदम विद्यालय विकास योजना की प्राथमिकताओं को अनुमानित लागतों से जोड़कर व्यवस्थित बजट बनाना है। इससे खर्च पहले से तय लक्ष्यों के अनुरूप रहता है।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)

questions.question_english: Identify the INCORRECT pair regarding Re- appropriation:
options_english: Re-appropriation authority – Delegated strictly to specific competent administrative authorities under financial rules
Timing of Re-appropriation – Must be formally completed before the official expiry of the financial year
Object of Re-appropriation – To maximize the efficient and effective use of allocated funds within a single grant
Scope of Re-appropriation – Permitted between Revenue and Capital sections at DDO level
questions.explanation_english: Scope of Re-appropriation – Permitted between Revenue and Capital sections at DDO level. Re-appropriation between Revenue and Capital sections is strictly prohibited at the DDO level under government financial rules. Capital and Revenue accounts represent distinct financial structures with different statutory implications. Matching the scope of re-appropriation with DDO-level transfers between Capital and Revenue sections is incorrect, making statement D the false pair
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। DDO स्तर पर राजस्व और पूंजीगत अनुभागों के बीच स्वतंत्र पुनर्विनियोजन की अनुमति नहीं होती; इस विषय में विशिष्ट वित्तीय अधिकार और नियम लागू होते हैं।
key_facts: Answer key: (D)

questions.question_english: A school has been running a specialized “Calligraphy Club” for ten years. Under a Zero- Based Budgeting review, the Principal finds that only two students currently participate, yet the club consumes a significant portion of the co- curricular budget. Which of these actions aligns with ZBB principles?
options_english: Continuing the calligraphy club’s annual budget without modification simply because it represents a legacy institutional program
Eliminating the club’s budget and reallocating funds to high-demand activities
Reducing the calligraphy club’s requested budget allocation by a flat rate of exactly 5% as a reasonable administrative compromise
Secretly transferring the unutilized portion of the club’s operational funds into a capital asset fund without formal authorization
questions.explanation_english: Eliminating the club’s budget and reallocating funds to high-demand activities. Under Zero-Based Budgeting principles, every activity must demonstrate ongoing utility, cost efficiency, and alignment with current priorities. A club with minimal student involvement cannot justify its financial allocation simply due to institutional history. Eliminating its budget and redirecting resources to high-demand educational initiatives aligns directly with ZBB’s focus on optimal, outcome-driven resource allocation
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। ZBB में पुरानी परंपरा के आधार पर खर्च जारी नहीं रखा जाता। कम भागीदारी और अधिक लागत होने पर कार्यक्रम का औचित्य जाँचना और धन अधिक उपयोगी गतिविधियों में लगाना उचित है।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)
